title: Attach known inputs instead of paying for worker exploration
summary: When a delegated task's inputs are known and small, attach them (orchestrate delegate --attach, eval route suffix +attach) as untrusted-data documents. EVR-0013 (EVS-SECURITY, gpt-6-luna, 3 samples each): accuracy 1.0 vs 1.0 (noninferior), input tokens 17.6k vs 55.7k (-68%), latency 9.5 s vs 29.2 s (-68%), matching EXP-0007. Attached tasks are self-contained, so API workers (role inline) can serve them once a key exists. Not applied to engine coding workers, which must explore and edit the repository.
